title: Smart Summary & Action Items
description: Automatically summarize long documents, emails, and meeting transcripts into a 3–5 bullet summary plus clearly extracted action items.
details: Suggested assignees and due dates inferred from calendar and mention context.

title: Context-aware Natural Language Search
description: Let users ask in plain language and return prioritized results across files, email, and chats.

title: Adaptive Prioritization & Focus Mode
description: Rank tasks using deadlines, effort, and personal work patterns.
details: Propose optimized focus blocks and auto-snooze low-priority interruptions.

title: Automated Workflow Composer
description: Build repeatable workflows from natural-language prompts.
details: Preview steps, check permissions, and let users approve. Example: "send weekly report to team on Monday".

title: Meeting Assistant with Real-time Notes & Decisions
description: Produce live notes and extract decisions and action items.
details: Assign owners and sync items to tasks and calendar; provide searchable summaries post-meeting.

title: Writing Coach & Tone Adjuster
description: Suggest edits for clarity, brevity, and tone based on audience; offer alternative phrasings.
details: Flag potential issues (ambiguous wording, missing context).

title: Smart Template & Snippet Manager
description: Recommend templates and snippets based on context and auto-fill variables.

title: Personal Knowledge Graph & Q&A
description: Link people, projects, and documents into a private graph.
details: Support conversational Q&A with cited sources and confidence scores.

title: Auto Data Insight Generator
description: Scan spreadsheets and BI datasets to surface trends, anomalies, and suggested visualizations.
details: Provide natural-language summaries and next-step suggestions.

title: Privacy-aware Controls & Explainability
description: Expose which data the model used and provide concise explanations for suggestions.
details: Offer scoped/on-device options for sensitive content.
